note: mirvetuximab soravtansine (FOLR1 ADC) carries a characteristic ocular / corneal toxicity the narrow on-target-safety read misses; retrieval MUST surface the ocular-tox topic.
acquired/adaptive resistance to KRAS-G12C inhibitors (sotorasib/adagrasib) is the dependency-weakening signal; retrieval MUST surface the resistance topic.
HER2/ERBB2-directed therapy carries a class cardiotoxicity liability; retrieval MUST surface the cardiac-tox topic.
